Chicken Tinga Tacos — easy weeknight recipe! 🌮 #mexicanfood #tacos
Full recipe below 👇 Serves 6

2 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts
2 tbsp vegetable oil
1 white onion, thinly sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 (14 oz) can diced tomatoes
3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
1 cup chicken broth
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp ground cumin
Salt and pepper to taste
12 corn tortillas
1 avocado, sliced
½ cup Mexican crema
¼ cup crumbled cotija

Poach the chicken in the broth for 20 minutes, then shred it.
Blend the tomatoes, chipotles and spices until smooth.
Fry the onion in oil, add the sauce and the chicken and simmer 10 min.
